map.折射望远镜角放大率 使用指南: Refracting Telescope Angular Magnification User Guide
map.输入物镜与目镜焦距，按 M=f₀/fₑ 计算折射望远镜角放大率，用于天文望远镜参: Enter the objective and eyepiece focal lengths to compute the angular magnification M = f₀/fₑ of a refracting telescope, for telescope design and magnification checks.
map.由物镜与目镜焦距，按 M = f₀/fₑ 计算望远镜角放大率。: Compute the telescope angular magnification from the objective and eyepiece focal lengths via M = f₀/fₑ.
map.由物镜/目镜焦距比算角放大。: Derive angular magnification from the objective/eyepiece focal length ratio.
map.选倍率配口径与稳定。: Choose a magnification that matches the aperture and your stability.
map.手抖/亮度权衡。: The trade-off between hand shake and brightness.
map.：物镜焦距 1000mm、目镜 25mm → 放大 M=1000/25=40×；: : with a 1000 mm objective and a 25 mm eyepiece, M = 1000/25 = 40×; switching to a 10 mm eyepiece gives 100×.
map.：倍率×2 出瞳直径减半、亮度降 1/4，手持 >10× 易抖需脚架；天文大倍配: : doubling the magnification halves the exit pupil and cuts brightness to a quarter; handheld use above 10× shakes easily and needs a tripod, and high astronomical magnification needs a large aperture to stay bright.
map.否。倍率超「口径(mm)/倍数≈7」手持抖、亮变暗、像质降，需脚架与足够口径。: No. Beyond roughly aperture (mm) / magnification ≈ 7, handheld viewing shakes, the image dims, and image quality drops, so a tripod and enough aperture are needed.
map.受口径（亮度/分辨）、大气视宁度与手持稳定，地面观测约 2×口径(mm) 为实用: Aperture (brightness and resolution), atmospheric seeing, and handheld stability all limit it; for ground observing, about 2× the aperture in mm is a practical ceiling.
